chunk_map.heading: A skill's footprint is where its job lands
Composition is a live argument, so you read

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Harm the rule prevents: a reader hits a pronoun/noun with no antecedent and stalls. Not present here. Chunk0 line3 'You have a kit now: a test-strategy skill, a verifier, and a freshly drawn map of the moves worth packaging next' names the kit's three parts in the same sentence, not a bare pronoun -- and it's also arc-earned: M5's `learn-from-the-test.md` line 60 includes `lectures/what-packaging-is.md`, which is exactly where 'test-strategy skill / verifier / map' get built (confirmed by grep). Chunk2 line17 'One documented kit wires skills.' -- 'skills' resolves to chunk1 line9's bolded **skill** definition; 'One documented kit' is a fresh indefinite noun phrase elaborated in the rest of its own sentence, not a pronoun needing a prior antecedent, so no resolution failure. The diff under review (loss of 'four ways' after 'wires skills') removes a quantifier, not a referent -- 'skills' still points at the same earlier-defined noun either way.

Harm prevented: a chunk pointing at another file 'by position' (which opener, which page) so the reader can't find it. Line26 '[Dino's skill stacking system](trainings/agentic-engineering-101/supplementary/skill-stacking.md)' and line28 '[Workflow composition lineages](...)' name the document by title, not position -- the exempted navigational-pointer shape. Line3 'the passage you already sailed' doesn't locate a file by position either; it's the module-arc carve-out (verified against `learn-from-the-test.md`/`what-packaging-is.md` above).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Harm prevented: 'the X you did/saw' pointing at a beat the current module set no longer has. Line3's 'the passage you already sailed' + this file's own maintainer block line43 ('Base geometry is the M5 passage chart from what-packaging-is.md, byte-unchanged') both resolve to `curriculum/lectures/what-packaging-is.md`, which is live and included by M5 (`learn-from-the-test.md:60`) -- verified by grep, not inferred. Beat exists.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No guess-before-reveal instruction anywhere in the body -- the file is expository (figure + two mechanics passages + a pointer to two reads), not a live-demo beat. Rule has no object here.

Harm prevented: a chunk whose only content is a wait-state, projecting as an empty slide. Each of the 4 chunks carries a self-carrying claim or a dense bullet list (chunk1: figure + 3 defining bullets; chunk2: 6 bullets building skill->workflow; chunk3: thesis sentence + 2 named pointers + a closing line). None reduces to one context-dependent bullet.

Harm prevented: a header the chunk's own content contradicts. Header1 'A skill's footprint is where its job lands' (line5) is restated near-verbatim by bullet2 (line10) 'Its **footprint** is wherever the job lands' -- true. Header3 'Composition is a live argument, so you read' (line22) is restated by its own first sentence (line24) -- true. Header2 'From skills to a workflow' (line13) is a transition/orientation label rather than a full claim; the file's own maintainer block (line51) already adjudicates it under `check_lectures §4` as naming 'the composition concept the slide teaches in its variety' -- existing accept-note, and the content (bullets1-3: individual-skill wiring mechanisms; bullets4-6: workflow-level checks/judgment) does trace exactly that path, so it holds even unaided.

Harm prevented: a slide-visible tic (triad, self-grading superlative, empty-leg verb triplet, number+retraction). Ran `grep -niE '\bNot [A-Z][a-z]+\. Not [A-Z][a-z]+\.'` over the body -> exit 1 (0 matches, 'Not X. Not Y. Z.' absent). Ran `grep -niE 'one of the (most|best)|most useful|most powerful'` -> exit 1 (0 matches, no self-grading superlative). Closest specimen to the anaphora-triple sub-item: line11 'Nothing here is new except the placing. Same passage, same drift, same fixes and guardrails.' -- three 'same' repetitions, but the rule's own exception is satisfied: the third leg ('fixes and guardrails') is NEW concrete content (two chart elements not named in legs 1-2), not a restatement -- stays inside per the rule's own carve-out. The diff under review removed a number ('four') rather than adding a number+retraction pair, so that sub-item isn't triggered either way.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Harm prevented: repo/maintainer vocabulary (surface-as-noun, firing, compendium, forcing function, beat-as-noun, mood, Connections) projected where the room can't parse it. Ran `grep -niE '\bsurface\b|\bfiring\b|\bcompendium\b|\bforcing function\b|\bbeat\b|\bmood\b|\bConnections\b'` over body lines 1-31 -> exit 1, 0 matches. Terms used in-body (skill, footprint, orchestrator, routing, hand-off, leaf, pilot) are the lecture's own taught vocabulary, bridged once per the maintainer block's 'Vocabulary bridge' note (line45), not maintainer dialect.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Harm prevented: whole-sentence bolding drowning the handle signal. Existing maintainer accept-note (line34, Antti-directed) documents and defends the exact bold spans present: slide1 **skill**+**footprint** as sub-span handles on two different defining bullets; slide2 the four wiring-mechanism handles (**an explicit load** / **an orchestrator** / **routing** / **a hand-off**) plus **leaf** at its definition -- five short handles on one definitional/consolidation slide, matching the rule's own 'a law/consolidation slide may carry one handle per law' clause. Unchanged by the diff under review (no bold spans were touched). Per dispatch-preamble instruction to check the maintainer block for an existing accept-note before flagging, this is pre-cleared.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Presence precedes content — verify against the composed deck, not long-read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Harm prevented: a phase-less section present in long-read but absent from the composed Slides deck. Ran `node scripts/slides.test.js` -> 24/24 pass, 0 fail (deck composition, phase-wrapper inclusion, anchor resolution, click navigation all green). The file is included via `[Composing the workflow](lectures/composing-the-workflow.md)` inside `spot-gaps-build-the-loop.md`'s `## Human close` (verified: line 47 of that module file), the identical include shape used by its three sibling lecture links on the surrounding lines -- no reason this file diverges from a mechanism the test suite exercises directly.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Slide size — 210 words / 6 bullets, and the cap is machine-checked.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Ran `node scripts/check-slide-size.js --file curriculum/lectures/composing-the-workflow.md` -> 'files: 1  slides: 3  limits: 210 words / 6 bullets ... oversized: 0 ... every slide is within limits.' Mechanical, exit clean, no accept-note needed.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Harm prevented: a lecture heading that reads as a task label rather than a claim, muddying the exercise/lecture mood split. Header1 (line5) and header3 (line22) are explicit declarative claims. Header2 'From skills to a workflow' (line13) is transition/orientation-shaped rather than a bare claim; the file's own maintainer block (line51) already adjudicates it as intentional under `check_lectures §4` -- existing accept-note per the dispatch-preamble instruction to check for one before flagging -- and it fits the rule's own 'orientation headers' carve-out by function (a bridge line, like 'The far half opens').

notes: The diff under review ("One documented kit wires skills four ways." -> "One documented kit wires skills.", line17) is an NVA-quantifier cut already attributed to check_writing.md §20 by the dispatch note and is out of this class's lane -- it doesn't break any check_slides.md rule: the sentence's referent ('skills') still resolves (rule1), the header it sits under still self-carries via the maintainer's own accept-note (rule6), the bullet still visibly carries four bolded mechanism handles plus leaf regardless of whether a numeral names the count (rule9, unaffected), and no cadence-tic sub-item of rule7 is newly tripped by removing a number (that sub-item fires on a number PLUS its own retraction in the same breath, which requires a number to be present -- here there is none left to retract). Flagging this back to the writing-class judge, not filing here.
